# The One Ring fixtures as a deck

Every German card note in this folder — `Buckler` and `Bog-Shambler` say
`language: en` and stay out. The adversary prints `large` on its own; a
deck is one grid, so `card-size:` here puts everything on poker.

```cardsmith-deck
system: tor2e
card-type: [npc, gear]
card-languages: de
card-size: poker
paper-size: A4 portrait
```
